entry.summary:
Vendor: Geekvape
Type: Tank

The Geek Vape BARON 24mm RDA is a performance dripper implementing a large expansive two-post build deck and multifunctional airflow system for a dynamic range of vapor production output unlike any other. The Geek Vape BARON hosts a dual post build deck, top secured via flathead screws arranged in a single or dual coil layout. Airflow for the BARON RDA is drawn through the slotted top cap, past the selected airflow option of the fixed inner cap and vents directly to the coil configuration through either a slotted or drilled 3x4 hole pattern.

At the base of the Baron sits a stainless steel 510 connector that can accept a gold-plated BF squonk pin to allow for squonking of eJuice onto the coil configuration with the gentle pump from today's best squonk mods. In addition, the Baron is lightly knurled at the top cap to provide a better grip for those trying to adjust the airflow. Catering to cloud chasers, the BARON RDA comes with multiple drip tip options, such as a large PMMA widebore and a beautiful Resin widebore drip tip with the option of 510 drip tip adapter.

entry.title: Vaporesso iTank Subohm Tank
entry.summary:
Vendor: Vaporesso
Type: Tank
Price: 1500.00

The Vaporesso iTank is an ideal option for anyone that's looking for increased vapour production and a genuine sub ohm vape. Thanks to being compatible with the whole range of Vaporesso GTi coils, this tank delivers a DTL (Direct To Lung) inhale. As well as the tank itself, you’ll also find a 0.2 Ohm and a 0.4 Ohm GTi mesh coil in the box, so you’re able to connect to your mod and vape right away.

Quick Links:

Vaporesso GTi Coil Series

Features:

  • 2ml Sub Ohm Tank
  • DTL Vaping
  • Adjustable Airflow
  • Top Filling
  • Compatible With High VG E-Liquids
  • Mesh Vape Coils Included

With its standard 510 connection, you can pair the iTank with most mods on the market. Beyond that, the range of compatible coils are all sub ohm, which means your tank is specifically designed to create a larger amount of vapour for DTL vaping. Plus, it features an adjustable airflow which allows you to set the feel of the inhale to be tighter or looser.

As it's a top filling vape tank, you don’t even have to detach it from your mod to refill. Simply unscrew the top cap to reveal the inlet and fill with up to 2ml of your chosen e-liquid. For best results with either of the included coils, we’d suggest that your e-liquid has a 70% VG concentration or higher. Also, when vaped, the mesh design of the coils produce an improved flavour due to heating up the e-liquid faster.

Box Contains:

  • Vaporesso 2ml iTank
  • 0.2 Ohm Vaporesso GTi Mesh Coil
  • 0.4 Ohm Vaporesso GTi Mesh Coil
  • 3 x O-Ring
  • Spare Glass
  • User Manual

entry.title: Vaporesso iTank M
entry.summary:
Vendor: Vaporesso
Type: Tank
Price: 1650.00

The Vaporesso iTank M is a compact 3ml vape tank is easy to maintain and uses coils that are push-fit, meaning there's less mess. The adjustable airflow allows you to set how tight or loose you want the inhale to feel. The 1.2 Ohm MTX coil that's included with the tank will create an MTL (Mouth To Lung) inhale with a discreet amount of vapour. The iTank M is compatible with any mod that use a 510 connection.

Features:

  • 3ml Capacity
  • MTL Inhale
  • Top Filling Tank
  • Adjustable Airflow
  • Compatible With MTX Coils
  • Pair With 50% Or Higher PG E-Liquids

This tank is top filling, so you don't even have to take it off the mod to refill when it's empty, just push and twist the top cap to reveal the e-liquid inlet. The MTX 1.2 Ohm coil is best used between 8 - 12W, which creates an inhale that feels similar to a cigarette. As an MTL tank, the iTank M works well with e-liquids that are have a 50% PG concentration or a high PG blend.

Contains:

  • Vaporesso iTank M Vape Tank
  • 1.2 Ohm Vaporesso MTX Coil
  • User Manual
